title: PlanZV – Planzeichen für Bauleitpläne (Anlage zur Planzeichenverordnung 1990)
publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz (gesetze-im-internet.de); ordinance of the Federal Government
version: PlanZV 1990, last amended by Art. 6 G v. 12.08.2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 189)
license_note: Official work (§ 5 UrhG). The PlanZV gives colours only as names ('colour_name'); the hex values are the xPlanBox default styles of the matching XPlanung classes (de-facto convention, not law). Colours sampled from the JPEG scans of the Anlage are deliberately not used.
note: Key is the number of the Planzeichen in the Anlage ('9', '10.1', '13.2.1' ...); purpose pictograms (Zweckbestimmung) and the letters of 13.3 are matched by their German name, e.g. {'nr': '9', 'zweckbestimmung': 'Parkanlage'}. Only the open-space groups 4.2, 5, 6, 9-13, 15.13 and the building-use groups 1.1-1.4 are covered. PlanZV applies to Bauleitpläne only and is a 'Soll' rule: signs may be adapted and supplemented (§ 2 Abs. 2, 3).
